turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on days and months?
turns.tutor:
Days and months come soon. First, clock times. I solve one: Class ends ___ 3 o'clock.
Step 1: I find the time word: "3 o'clock".
Step 2: I ask: is it a day, a month or a clock time? A clock time.
Step 3: Clock times take at. So: Class ends at 3 o'clock.
Rule: use at before a clock time.
Right: I go to bed at 10 o'clock. Wrong: I go to bed in 10 o'clock.
Now you. Write one word:
Write in, on or at: My train leaves ___ 5 o'clock.
